last_summary: Replication Watch run 2 (gear 1, free deepseek-v4.1-flash). +3 validations, 0-water gap CLOSED: (1) EZ water in plant xylem (Wang & Pollack, Sci Rep 14:12071, 2024; medium) — EZ forms against xylem of cabbage/celery/asparagus/pumpkin, widths 133-240um, 94% fill of 80um vessel in 4min, <10% at 500uM NaCl; positive but originating-lab, ex vivo. (2) Passive copper-dowel 'electroculture' NULL (Chier et al., PLOS ONE 20(8):e0329615, 2025; high) — NSF-funded, n=10 x 4 species, no consistent yield/photosynthesis benefit; rods transmit ~2mV vs hundreds of V in active electro-culture. (3) Magnetized irrigation water on caraway (Abd Elkareem et al., Sci Rep 16:16295, 2026; medium) — 2 seasons, split-plot x3; fruit +10.4%, essential oil +24.6%, soil EC down; mechanism untested.
